obvious.en: There is an obvious difference between food from India and food that was created in Britain by people of South Asian heritage .
obvious.zh: 来自印度的食物与由南亚血统的人在英国创造的食物之间存在明显的区别。

obvious.en: The most obvious choice is fish and chips: fried fish, usually cod or haddock, with thick-cut chips served with salt and vinegar.
obvious.zh: 最明显的选择是炸鱼薯条：炸鱼，通常是鳕鱼或黑线鳕，配上厚切薯条，佐以盐和醋。

obvious.en: So the world's biggest technology companies did something unexpected, or I guess rather obvious when you understand that electricity is their biggest constraint .
obvious.zh: 于是，全球最大的科技公司做了一件出人意料的事，或者说，当你明白电力是他们最大的瓶颈时，这其实是顺理成章的。
